expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Five days, and a night on the water in the middle of it. That is the shortest trip I would call a proper taste of the north.
expert.tip: Ask for an upper deck cabin on the cruise. The bay is at its quietest just after sunrise and you will want to be outside for it.

summary: Five days in the north: a night in Hanoi, an overnight cruise among the limestone islands of Halong Bay with all meals on board and the Surprise Cave, then two nights back in the city with a full day out to the rivers and pagodas of Ninh Binh.
included: Included: 4 nights with daily breakfast, one of them on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay; the Surprise Cave; a Ninh Binh day tour with lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
